title: nrf_fuel_gauge init: nrf_model_init_43a1b0
approach: Bottom-up continuation after ttf. Idiomatic scalar-float C vs typographic stock on Renode 1.17 Cortex-M55, normal AAPCS, no fg_call. Typographic delayed-vmrs CFG (bge/bmi, not blt) for the temps window, typographic-order VFP helpers for the param_2/6/7 voltage interpolator (no 0x3FFFFFFF wrap; delayed bls uses last?v). The 439e9c-window clamp is only the param_9 query; voltage still uses the first-clamp T. Compared state[0x00..0xDF] and adjusted_v; unwritten 0xE0-0xE7 prefills were identical. No zero_s16 around calls. Init does not call 43bb14.

verified.notes: Init. Copies opt into state, records temps {hi,lo,count} at 0xAC/0xB0/0xB4, gathers or 43a5dc-interpolates param_9, v += i*param_9, then delayed-vmrs interp of param_2/6/7. 43a0f4(v) may zero the interp result. Writes state through 0xDC and *adjusted_v. Default opt, uniform EVENBAT-like tables, inverted/equal temps, IEEE specials and NaN payloads, 200 random cases. MAGIC 0xF6A11E06.
